📍Riga, Latvia 🇱🇻 If you’re looking for a European Christmas market that’s a little less obvious, put Riga on your list. 🎄✨ The Christmas market is right in the heart of Riga’s Old Town, around Dome Square, with wooden stalls selling artisan crafts, gifts and plenty of festive treats. You can try traditional Latvian food like 🫛🥓 grey peas with bacon, 🥟 piragi and 🍪 gingerbread, along with steaming cups of mulled wine and Riga Black Balsam. 🎶 There are also live performances, traditional Latvian folk music, carol singing and dancing throughout the festive season. Riga is definitely one to consider for a festive European getaway! ✨ 🧷 Save this reel & share it with someone who loves Christmas markets 🎄 #riga #rīgā #rigaoldtown #rigachristmasmarket #christmasmarkets
